name: Slice exit lock
notes: The vertical slice's locked iron exit (docs/design/vertical-slice.md B7): the Forgotten miner's rusted gallery key opens it (mw-e01.6 adds that key with key.opens ["slice-exit"]). A tier-2 lock a thief could pick at pick tier 2 (the minigame is mw-e10). Without a key the prompt says only "Locked." (mw-e01.4 AC-3).
